purpose: Accumulate chronology-safe authorized Smart Money observations prospectively and emit only already-approved RK-MIS 4Q features after sufficient point-in-time evidence exists, avoiding sparse historical reconstruction and hindsight.

fii_holding_pct.source_normalization: FII may be normalized to an authorized provider's institutional FPI category only when source semantics are explicit.

observation_identity: ISIN preferred; symbol allowed only when ISIN is unavailable and must not silently merge across identity changes.
point_in_time_rule: period_end <= known_at <= feature_as_of_date; observations known after the as-of date are excluded.
revision_rule: For each distinct period, use the latest authorized observation known by the as-of date. Later revisions do not rewrite earlier point-in-time snapshots.
component_completeness_rule: A derived 4Q feature requires its source field to be present in all five selected periods; missing intermediate periods are not imputed.
change_rule: latest selected period value minus earliest selected period value
source_rule: Record source URL/kind/grade and optional source SHA-256. Credentials and provider tokens must never be stored in the evidence database.
score_rule: This tracker does not change RK-MIS score weights or bands. It only produces existing approved feature fields when evidence qualifies.
prospective_holdout_rule: Outcome evaluation, if later performed, must use a separately preregistered predictor snapshot frozen before the outcome period.
